elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations apply upon both expiry and termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason” to all three exit obligations.
HDI is required to “provide reasonable transition assistance” at the Company's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly available “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.

elements.evidence: HDI must “return all Content and all customer and user data relating to the Site,” which identifies the relevant customer-data scope.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Item (ii), governed by the introductory expiry-or-termination trigger, requires return “within thirty (30) days.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” satisfying the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must certify its deletion.
elements.evidence: HDI must “thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: The transition and data-export obligations apply upon both expiry and termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
HDI must “provide reasonable transition assistance” when requested by the Company.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which includes the requested 90-day period.
Returning all Content and customer and user data in a commonly used, machine-readable format constitutes a data export.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The machine-readable return is required “within thirty (30) days” of the introductory expiry-or-termination trigger.

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It covers both expiry and termination, six months of requested transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return within 30 days, and subsequent written deletion certification. The existing termination-payment terms remain unchanged, and the added provisions are confined to exit assistance and data handling.
